# Performance Check — Studor

**Date:** 05.06.2026  
**Dataset:** 300 rows · synthetic · ~12% label noise  
**Metrics source:** `Outputs/metrics.json` (generated by `Source/ml_model.py`)

---

## Model Performance

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Test Accuracy | **91.11%** |
| Validation Accuracy | **88.89%** |
| 5-Fold CV Mean Accuracy | **86.67%** |
| 5-Fold CV Std Dev | **0.0513** |
| Test Macro F1 | **0.91** |
| Train / Val / Test Split | 70% / 15% / 15% (210 / 45 / 45) |
| Algorithm | Random Forest (`random_state=42`, default hyperparameters) |

Full evaluation: `Documentation/evaluation_report.md`.

---

## Application Response Times (localhost, indicative)

| Operation | Approx. time |
|---|---|
| Cold app start (first load) | ~3–5 s (Supabase `init_db` + model load) |
| Subsequent page navigation | < 200 ms (model cached via `@st.cache_resource`) |
| Login / Register (DB round-trip) | ~300–600 ms (depends on network) |
| Risk prediction (`model.predict`) | < 10 ms |
| Dashboard load (CSV read + Plotly) | ~200–400 ms (CSV cached via `@st.cache_data`) |

**Note:** `init_db()` runs on each app session via `bootstrap.ensure_database()`; table creation is idempotent and typically fast after the first connection.

---

## Database (Supabase PostgreSQL)

| Parameter | Notes |
|---|---|
| Connection | `DATABASE_URL` in `.env` (not committed) |
| Tables | `users`, `sessions`, `courses`, `pdfs`, `predictions` |
| Auth | bcrypt password hashes; optional security-question reset |
| Predictions | Written on successful Risk Prediction (`save_prediction`) |

---

## Known Limitations

1. **Synthetic data** — metrics are not real-world indicators of model quality.
2. **No hyperparameter tuning** — default Random Forest parameters used.
3. **Single-node deployment** — Streamlit local or Streamlit Cloud; no horizontal scaling.
4. **Saved predictions** — stored in the database but not yet displayed on the Profile page (session-only summary today).
5. **Remember Me** — uses `streamlit-cookies-controller`; may not persist in strict privacy/incognito modes.
